hints.title: Character Ending State Tracking
hints.text: Maintain counts of distinct subsequences ending in each of the 26 lowercase English letters.

hints.title: Contribution Addition Principle
hints.text: Appending character c to any existing subsequence (or starting a new single-character subsequence with c) creates total plus 1 new subsequences ending in c.

hints.title: Modular Frequency DP
hints.text: Keep an array of size 26 tracking additions per character. Maintain running total. For each character c, compute new distinct subsequences formed, update running total modulo 10^9 + 7, and record the contribution of character c. Return the total modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsequences into a hash set causes exponential time and memory exhaustion for N up to 2000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking ending character counts compresses states to 26 integers, yielding linear time and strictly constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should understand how duplicate subsequences arise when the same character appears multiple times and how to deduplicate via overwrite or contribution subtraction.
complexity.notes: Can also be maintained in O(N) by tracking running total and subtracting previous ends_with[c].
